fato_historico: 1958: A team of rock climbers led by Warren Harding completes the first ascent of The Nose on El Capitan in Yosemite Valley.
energia_do_dia: Today invites you to conquer your own personal summits with the grace of a seasoned climber. Much like the legendary ascent of El Capitan, you may find that patience and steady progress are your best allies. It is a good time to trust your inner strength and acknowledge that even the steepest challenges are within your reach.
frase_do_dia: Great things come from courage and staying focused on the mountain top.
significado_numero: The energy of new beginnings and reaching your ultimate peak.
conselho: Focus on your goals one small step at a time today.
